# GLOBAL INTEGRATION - ALL CELLS
## SCTransform individually
```{r}
sts.seurat <- SplitObject(sts.seurat, split.by = "Sample")

for (i in names(sts.seurat)){
  sts.seurat[[i]] <- SCTransform(sts.seurat[[i]],
    vst.flavor = "v2",
    method = "glmGamPoi",
    verbose = TRUE
    )
}
```

## INTEGRATION
### CSS integration - 'orig.ident'
```{r css-integration, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
# Codes modified from Fernando
# Merge and set common features 
features.ls <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = sts.seurat, nfeatures = 2000) #default nfeatures

sts.simspec_css.sample.sct <- merge(x = sts.seurat[[1]], y = sts.seurat[2:length(sts.seurat)], 
                                  merge.data = TRUE)

VariableFeatures(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct) <- features.ls

# PCA 
sts.simspec_css.sample.sct <- RunPCA(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct, verbose = TRUE, assay = "SCT") #default npcs = 50

# Run CSS ----
# simspec is installed in the conda env at the commit used for the manuscript (envs/post_install.R)
# (quadbio/simspec f4c87bfb18522d7df0110eb63843972a29415985), originally with:
# devtools::install_github("quadbiolab/simspec")
library(simspec)

# On running simspec_CSS on SCTranformed objects https://github.com/immunogenomics/simspec_CSS/issues/41
sts.simspec_css.sample.sct <-
  simspec::cluster_sim_spectrum(
    object = sts.simspec_css.sample.sct,
    label_tag = "orig.ident", #original sample labels from pre-processing step
    cluster_resolution = 0.4,
    corr_method = "pearson",
    spectrum_type = "corr_kernel"
  )

cat("Current reductions in object:", Reductions(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct)) # pca css
# Current reductions in object: pca css

# Reference codes from:  https://github.com/quadbio/simspec/blob/master/vignette/vignette.md
sts.simspec_css.sample.sct <- RunUMAP(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct, reduction = "css", 
                                   dims = 1:ncol(Embeddings(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct, "css")), #294
                                   reduction.name="umap_css", reduction.key="UMAPCSS_")

sts.simspec_css.sample.sct <- FindNeighbors(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct, reduction="css", 
                                         dims = 1:ncol(Embeddings(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct, "css")))


sts.simspec_css.sample.sct <- FindClusters(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct, algorithm = 3, resolution = c(0.8,0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2))
sts.simspec_css.sample.sct <- FindClusters(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct, algorithm = 3, resolution = 1.1)

library(clustree)
clustree::clustree(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct)
```

```{r umap-clusters, fig.width=16, fig.height=8}
DimPlot(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct, raster = F, group.by = "SCT_snn_res.1.1", label = T) + DimPlot(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct, group.by = "cell_class",label = T, repel =T, raster = F)
saveRDS(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct, file = file.path(params$step_dir, "sts.simspec_css.sample.sct.clustered.RDS"))

```

## Annotation - Sample SCT -> 'orig.ident' CSS integration
`simspec_cell_class` was assigned to the resolution-1.1 clusters by number in the original analysis. Cluster numbers are not stable across environments, so `simspec_cell_class` is read from the deposited annotated object, matched by cell ID (`reference_labels.RDS`, written by `Seurat_sample_based.Rmd`). The original mapping is kept below, and checked against the deposited object's own clusters.

```{r original-mapping-check, results='asis'}
reference_labels <- readRDS(file.path(params$out_root, "Seurat_sample_based", "reference_labels.RDS"))

# Original mapping of resolution-1.1 clusters to simspec_cell_class, applied to the deposited object's clusters
if ("SCT_snn_res.1.1" %in% colnames(reference_labels)) {
  clusters <- data.frame(Cell_Ids = reference_labels$Cell_Ids,
                         seurat_clusters = as.character(reference_labels$SCT_snn_res.1.1))

  clusters <-
    clusters %>% dplyr::mutate(
      simspec_cell_class = dplyr::case_when(
        seurat_clusters %in% c("0","2","3","4","7","9","11","12","14","15","21","22","24","27","34","40","45") ~ "PDAC",
        seurat_clusters %in% c("39") ~ "Tuft", #check
        seurat_clusters %in% c("5", "33") ~ "Ductal_epithelial", #check
        seurat_clusters %in% c("30") ~ "Acinar", #check
        seurat_clusters %in% c("43","18","6","1") ~ "Malignant acinar", #check
        seurat_clusters %in% c("46","20","8") ~ "T/NK", #check
        seurat_clusters %in% c("10","13","29","47") ~ "CAFs", #check
        seurat_clusters %in% c("19","44","37","38") ~ "PDA_OLGC", #check
        seurat_clusters ==  "41" ~ "Mast", #check
        seurat_clusters ==  "32" ~ "B", #check
        seurat_clusters ==  "42" ~ "FRCs", #check
        seurat_clusters == "35" ~ "Plasma",#check
        seurat_clusters %in% c("16","17", "25", "31") ~ "Macrophages", #check
        seurat_clusters ==  "28" ~ "Endothelial", 
        seurat_clusters %in%  c("23", "26") ~ "Endocrine", 
        seurat_clusters == "36"  ~ "Pericytes" #done
        
      )
    )

  # NA (a cluster with no label) counts as a label of its own
  same <- mean(dplyr::coalesce(clusters$simspec_cell_class, "<none>") ==
                 dplyr::coalesce(as.character(reference_labels$simspec_cell_class), "<none>"))
  cat(sprintf("\n\nThe original mapping, applied to the deposited object's resolution-1.1 clusters, gives the deposited `simspec_cell_class` for %.4f%% of cells.\n\n", 100 * same))
} else {
  cat("\n\nThe deposited object has no `SCT_snn_res.1.1` column, so the original mapping cannot be checked.\n\n")
}
```

## Rerun UMAP next to the deposited UMAP
Both panels show the same cells coloured by `simspec_cell_class`. The left panel is the rerun UMAP; the right panel uses the coordinates stored in the deposited object, the layout of the published figures (Fig. 1B is drawn from them in Stage 4). The layouts can differ, rotated, flipped or shifted, because UMAP is sensitive to small numerical differences between environments; the same classes should still form the same groups.

```{r umap-rerun-vs-deposited, fig.width=20, fig.height=9}
if (all(c("deposited_UMAP_1", "deposited_UMAP_2") %in% colnames(reference_labels))) {
  coords <- as.matrix(reference_labels[idx, c("deposited_UMAP_1", "deposited_UMAP_2")])
  rownames(coords) <- colnames(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct)
  colnames(coords) <- c("depUMAPCSS_1", "depUMAPCSS_2")
  sts.simspec_css.sample.sct[["umap_css_deposited"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
    embeddings = coords, key = "depUMAPCSS_", assay = DefaultAssay(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct))
  print(DimPlot(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct, reduction = "umap_css", group.by = "simspec_cell_class",
                raster = F, label = T, repel = T) + ggtitle("Rerun UMAP") +
          DimPlot(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct, reduction = "umap_css_deposited", group.by = "simspec_cell_class",
                  raster = F, label = T, repel = T) + ggtitle("Deposited UMAP"))
} else {
  message("The reference object has no umap_css; the deposited UMAP is not shown")
}
```

## Rerun clusters compared with `simspec_cell_class`
Each rerun cluster at resolution 1.1, with the share of its cells in each `simspec_cell_class`.

```{r compare-simspec-cell-class, fig.width=10, fig.height=12, results='asis'}
compare_with_labels <- function(clusters, labels, title) {
  clusters <- as.character(clusters)
  labels <- as.character(labels)
  ari <- bluster::pairwiseRand(labels, clusters, mode = "index")
  counts <- table(cluster = clusters, label = labels)
  shares <- prop.table(counts, margin = 1)
  pheatmap(unclass(shares), cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
           color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "darkred"))(50),
           main = sprintf("%s (ARI %.3f)", title, ari))
  data.frame(cluster = rownames(shares),
             cells = as.vector(rowSums(counts)),
             majority_label = colnames(shares)[apply(shares, 1, which.max)],
             majority_share_pct = round(100 * apply(shares, 1, max), 1))
}

simspec_comparison <- compare_with_labels(sts.simspec_css.sample.sct$SCT_snn_res.1.1,
                                          sts.simspec_css.sample.sct$simspec_cell_class,
                                          "Rerun clusters vs simspec_cell_class")
print(knitr::kable(simspec_comparison, row.names = FALSE))
```
